description: Systematic AlphaFold2-Multimer/ColabFold protein-pair screen, Pfam domain architecture results, domain-class summary, and matrix of all tested protein pairs.
method_or_interpretation: The manuscript calls this Supplementary Table 9. The workbook filename spells AlphaFold as AlfaFold.

columns: 20 populated named columns plus one empty trailing column
data_type_or_values: one tested or reported protein pair per row
description: Protein-pair origin, interpretation, hit-rate summary, identifiers and annotations for both proteins, and structural confidence/interface metrics.
method_or_interpretation: Pairs include positive controls, within-module candidates, selected cross-module pairs, and negative/specificity controls.

data_type_or_values: HMMER hmmscan result rows; two header rows precede the data
description: Pfam-A domain hits for proteins involved in predicted high-confidence interactions.
method_or_interpretation: HMMER v3.3.2 hmmscan against Pfam-A v35.0. The sheet retains native full-sequence, best-domain, and domain-number-estimation statistics.

data_type_or_values: one functional domain class per row
description: Summary of unique domain types across 25 proteins involved in predicted high-confidence interactions.
method_or_interpretation: Classes include LRR, kinase, EDS1-family, metabolic, and regulatory domains.

rows: 324 partner rows after two header rows
description: All protein pairs submitted for structural screening, organized by query protein.
method_or_interpretation: Row 1 contains query labels; row 2 contains query PN40024 v4 gene IDs; subsequent cells list candidate partner gene IDs. Cross-module pairs are encoded as query:partner strings.

description: Optional category marker such as POSITIVE CONTROL.
method_or_interpretation: First column of AlphaFold_ColabFold.

description: Origin or sampling class of the protein pair.
method_or_interpretation: Examples include within co-transcriptional module and selected pair (cross-module).

description: Interpretive label for structural interface compatibility.
method_or_interpretation: Predictions are computational candidates and not experimental evidence of physical interaction.

description: Number of pairs passing all interface criteria divided by the number tested in the relevant set.
method_or_interpretation: High-confidence criteria: ipTM >= 0.70, mean pLDDT >= 50, at least 5 interface contacts, and contact-filtered mean iPAE < 10 Å.

description: PN40024 v4 gene identifier for each protein in the tested pair.
method_or_interpretation: The workbook repeats the same five annotation columns for the two proteins.

description: UniProt accession and optional protein name for each protein.
method_or_interpretation: Annotation field.

data_type_or_values: three genotype patterns using U, D, E
description: Time-resolved transcriptional pattern for Rpv12, Rpv12+Rpv1, and Rpv12+Rpv1+Rpv3.
method_or_interpretation: Within each three-character pattern, positions are 0, 6, and 24 hpi; U = upregulated, D = downregulated, E = equivalent to susceptible.

description: Closest annotated Arabidopsis thaliana homolog and description.
method_or_interpretation: Assigned through sequence-homology analysis.

description: Percent amino-acid sequence identity to the reported Arabidopsis homolog.
method_or_interpretation: Higher values indicate greater sequence identity.

description: Interface predicted TM-score from AlphaFold2-Multimer.
method_or_interpretation: Primary model-confidence metric for the predicted protein-protein interface; criterion >= 0.70.

description: Predicted global TM-score for the full complex.
method_or_interpretation: Global structural confidence metric.

description: Mean predicted Local Distance Difference Test confidence across residues.
method_or_interpretation: Per-residue model-confidence summary; criterion >= 50.

description: Mean inter-chain Predicted Aligned Error across residue pairs forming interface contacts.
method_or_interpretation: Interface contacts use C-alpha distance < 8 Å; high-confidence criterion is < 10 Å.

description: Fraction of interface contacts whose PAE is below 10 Å.
method_or_interpretation: Higher values indicate that a larger fraction of the modeled interface has low predicted alignment error.

description: Number of inter-chain residue contacts with C-alpha distance < 8 Å.
method_or_interpretation: High-confidence criterion is at least 5 contacts.

description: PN40024 v4 gene identifier for the protein carrying the domain hit.
method_or_interpretation: Domain_architecture sheet.

method_or_interpretation: Domain_architecture sheet.
